title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Mobile App Developer – React Native

**About DigiLantern**

DigiLantern is a technology company delivering digital solutions across Application Development, AI, and Digital Transformation. We work with businesses across North America to build scalable digital products and technology solutions.

Position Details

* **Designation:** Mobile App Developer
* **Experience:** 2\+ years
* **Location:** Noida, Sector 3
* **Work Mode:** On\-site
* **Workdays:** 5\.5 days, alternate Saturdays working
* **Interview:** 1st round virtual, final round face\-to\-face at our Noida office

What You'll Do

* Build and ship mobile features using **React Native, Expo and Expo Router**, including screens, navigation, modals and deep links.
* Develop fast, polished and responsive UI using **Reanimated, Gesture Handler and expo\-image**.
* Manage application state using **TanStack Query and Zustand** and build forms using **React Hook Form**.
* Integrate REST APIs and work with TypeScript\-based backend services.
* Implement authentication flows including social login and OTP, along with push notifications.
* Manage mobile releases using **EAS Build/Submit**, OTA updates and App Store/Play Store submissions.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production issues using tools such as **Sentry and Firebase**.
* Write and maintain E2E test flows and help ensure stable releases.

Must\-Have Skills

* **2\+ years of hands\-on React Native experience**
* At least **one live app** on the App Store or Google Play Store
* Strong **TypeScript and modern React** fundamentals
* Hands\-on experience with **Expo, Expo Router, EAS and dev\-client workflow**
* Good understanding of React Native performance, including list virtualization, re\-render optimization, image caching and UI\-thread animations
* Experience with **REST APIs, caching and optimistic updates**
* Comfortable debugging **Xcode, Android Studio, Gradle, CocoaPods and signing issues**
* Good Git practices and experience working in a monorepo

Good to Have

* Backend exposure with **Node.js, Hono or Express**
* Experience with SQL, ORMs or serverless platforms
* In\-app subscriptions or payment integrations
* Localization and accessibility
* E2E testing with **Maestro or Detox**
* Mobile CI/CD experience
* Exposure to **AI/LLM applications**

How to Apply

Please apply only if you are based in **Delhi/NCR** and are comfortable with the on\-site role in Noida. The first round will be conducted virtually, while the final round will be face\-to\-face at our office.

You can also reach out directly on **WhatsApp: 9821486056** with your resume and the following details:

* Current in\-hand salary
* Expected in\-hand salary
* Reason for change
* Relevant years of React Native experience
* How soon can you join

**Pankhuri Agarwal**  
Assistant Manager\-HR  
pankhuri.agarwal@digilantern.in  
9821486056  
www.digilantern.com

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

title: Mobile Financial Services Solution Consulting Manager
description:
**About this Opportunity:**
---------------------------

The Mobile Financial Services (MFS) Solution Consulting Manager is responsible for leading Solution Consulting, Banking \& Financial Services IT Transition Consulting, MFS/Fintech capability establishment and technology transformation initiatives within the MFS Professional Services organization.


The role acts as a strategic bridge between Customers, Sales, Product, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, Service Management and Commercial teams.


The individual will develop a deep understanding of the customer's business strategy, business model, operating model, products, processes, organization and existing IT landscape, and translate these insights into scalable, technically feasible, commercially viable and operationally sustainable MFS solutions.


The role will lead customer discovery, solution consulting, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, solution workshops, POCs, transformation consulting, IT transition and capability\-establishment initiatives.


The role will ensure continuity across the complete lifecycle:


Understand Customer Assess Business \& IT Define Target State Shape Solution Implement Transition Go\-Live Stabilize BAU Continuous Improvement

**What You will do:**
---------------------

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Understand customer business objectives, operating models, technology landscapes, and organizational capabilities.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, assessments, workshops, and strategic consulting engagements.
* Design end\-to\-end MFS and fintech solutions across Mobile Money, Digital Wallets, Digital Payments, Open Banking, Lending, Remittances, KYC/eKYC, Fraud Management, APIs, Analytics, and Core Banking integrations.
* Develop transformation roadmaps, target operating models, business cases, and value propositions.
* Lead Banking \& Financial Services IT transition programs, ensuring operational readiness, governance, risk management, and successful handover to BAU operations.
* Support strategic opportunities through solution development, RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, customer presentations, and executive engagements.
* Drive POCs, pilots, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Architecture, Engineering, Delivery, Operations, and Customer Success teams.
* Build consulting capabilities, mentor teams, and develop reusable frameworks, methodologies, and solution assets.

#### **Ideal Candidate Profile**


The ideal candidate is a senior banking, financial services, and fintech technology consulting professional who can seamlessly operate across both customer\-facing Solution Consulting and execution\-oriented IT Transition Consulting.


They should be able to understand and connect: Customer Business \+ Customer IT Landscape \+ People \+ Processes \+ Technology \+ Tools


and translate these insights into practical, scalable, and sustainable MFS and digital financial services solutions.


The successful candidate will be equally comfortable:

* Engaging C\-level banking and fintech executives.
* Assessing enterprise IT and technology landscapes.
* Shaping commercial and transformation propositions.
* Collaborating with architects and engineering teams.
* Defining operating models and governance frameworks.
* Establishing new capabilities and leading complex technology transitions.
**You will bring:**
-------------------


#### **Required Experience**

* 10\-15\+ years of experience in MFS, Fintech, Banking, Payments, Digital Banking, Technology Consulting, Solution Architecture, or Pre\-Sales.
* Strong expertise in solution consulting, customer advisory, enterprise solution design, and technology transformation.
* Proven experience in IT transition, operational readiness, service transformation, and technology modernization.
* Experience working with banks, financial institutions, fintechs, mobile network operators (MNOs), payment service providers, or technology partners.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Experience managing complex RFP/RFI/RFQ engagements and strategic customer opportunities.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Multi\-country fintech or MFS programs.
* Open Banking/Open Finance initiatives.
* Cloud transformation and banking modernization programs.
* Greenfield fintech or digital banking capability establishment.
* Experience building consulting or professional services organizations.

#### **Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, Finance, or a related field.
* MBA/Master's degree and relevant industry certifications preferred.

 **All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification.**

 **Why join Ericsson?**At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
